name: veil-poseidon2-crosscheck
description: Cross-checks the vendored circom Poseidon2 permutation (../vendor/poseidon2.circom, from @taceo/circom-lib) against an independent TypeScript implementation, @zkpassport/poseidon2, for fixed test vectors at every state size the vendored circuit supports (t = 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 16). Two independently-authored implementations agreeing on raw permutation output for the same inputs is the correctness evidence cited in docs/research/2026-08-19-poseidon2-arity-benchmark.md.
